overview_description.description: Bankiom is a digital bank that allows customers to open a current account and quickly download a virtual debit card on your smartphone. Bankiom is a UAE-based fintech app that provides a digital alternative to traditional banking through virtual prepaid cards, money transfers, and account management tools. It allows users to quickly create accounts, connect multiple bank accounts, send and receive money, and track spending through a mobile-first platform designed for simple, secure financial control and everyday payments.

about_short_description.short_description: Bankiom is a fintech app offering digital accounts, payments, transfers, and prepaid card services.

product.name: Bankiom Prepaid Card
product.description: A virtual prepaid card that can be obtained quickly and used for online and offline transactions without exchange fees, with features to manage and control card usage.

product.name: Bankiom Money Transfers
product.description: A service enabling instant peer-to-peer money transfers between users, allowing quick payments, requests, and detailed transfer history tracking.

product.name: Bank Account Aggregation and Management
product.description: A platform feature that connects and consolidates multiple bank accounts into one app, providing transaction tracking, spending insights, and easy top-ups.

product.name: YoungBucks Card
product.description: A virtual prepaid card designed for children and teens, managed by parents to teach financial responsibility through controlled spending and online transaction tracking.

product.name: Bankiom Credit Connect
product.description: A lending portal that matches users with suitable loan options, aiming to provide personalized loan offers within a few days.
